ui.tagline: Live another life in another world.
ui.cold_2: Something caught you in the dark between worlds.
ui.cold_3: When you open your eyes, the air smells of rain and forge-smoke.
ui.path_reincarnate_body: Wake in a new body in this world. Keep one Echo. Lose family, gold and home.
ui.path_heir_body: Pass the name, home and relics to your heir. No Echoes on this path.
ui.path_heir_locked: No child to carry your name
ui.child_born: A new life joins your line.
ui.mana_awakened: Mana answers you for the first time.

death.title: Those who came before
death.subtitle: Age {age}. {cause}.
death.summary_line: You leave behind {gold} gold, {heirs} living heirs, and a name the world may keep.
death.battle: A fight you do not walk away from.
death.illness: A sickness no healer can outrun.
death.accident: One bad step. That is all it takes.
death.magic_backfire: The spell turns. So does fortune.
death.execution: The law, or what claims to be.
death.unknown: No one agrees what happened. The songs disagree louder.
death.blurb: Pass the name, home and relics to your child. No Echoes. Their stats are their own, plus one lineage trait.
death.after: You wake as {heir_name}. The house still smells like them — like you.
death.locked: No child to carry your name
death.locked_hint: Adopt, apprentice or raise a ward if you want this path next time.
death.blood_iron: Your line endures pain a little longer.
death.relic_note: Relics pass only along the bloodline path.
death.low: A quiet life. The world barely noticed.
death.mid: Enough deeds for a tavern story.
death.high: Bards argue over which verse is true.
death.top: Empires measure years by your name.
